title: Bumblebee wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,12 36,38 64,38' fill='#ff4081'/>
  <polygon points='50,12 44,28 56,28' fill='#ff80ab'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='5' fill='#ffeb3b'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='24' r='2.5' fill='#00e5ff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='24' r='2.5' fill='#00e5ff'/>
  <!-- Hat brim -->
  <rect x='33' y='37' width='34' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffeb3b'/>
  <!-- Wings -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='46' rx='14' ry='8' fill='#b3e5fc' transform='rotate(-30 28 46)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='46' rx='14' ry='8' fill='#b3e5fc' transform='rotate(30 72 46)'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='46' rx='14' ry='8' fill='none' stroke='#81d4fa' stroke-width='2' transform='rotate(-30 28 46)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='46' rx='14' ry='8' fill='none' stroke='#81d4fa' stroke-width='2' transform='rotate(30 72 46)'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='20' ry='24' fill='#ffeb3b'/>
  <!-- Body stripes (dark but lit) -->
  <path d='M31 50 Q50 46 69 50' stroke='#6a1b9a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 62 Q50 58 70 62' stroke='#6a1b9a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M33 74 Q50 70 67 74' stroke='#6a1b9a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Stinger -->
  <polygon points='48,82 52,82 50,90' fill='#8d6e63'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='12' fill='#ffeb3b'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='2' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='40' r='2' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='39' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='39' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M44 47 Q50 52 56 47' stroke='#6a1b9a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Antennae -->
  <line x1='44' y1='31' x2='40' y2='22' stroke='#6a1b9a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='21' r='2.5' fill='#ff4081'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='31' x2='60' y2='22' stroke='#6a1b9a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='21' r='2.5' fill='#ff4081'/>
  <!-- Arms -->
  <line x1='31' y1='56' x2='22' y2='52' stroke='#ffeb3b' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='69' y1='56' x2='78' y2='52' stroke='#ffeb3b' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <line x1='42' y1='80' x2='38' y2='90' stroke='#6a1b9a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='82' x2='50' y2='92' stroke='#6a1b9a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='80' x2='62' y2='90' stroke='#6a1b9a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
